title: Army Advances in West Darfur, Recaptures Areas from RSF
detail: Middle East Monitor reports the Sudanese army advanced in West Darfur and recaptured areas from the RSF, while air strikes hit RSF positions in the North Kordofan villages of Umm Sumayma and Abu Harraz. An allAfrica weekly brief (Oct 10) likewise noted SAF advances in North Kordofan and West Darfur alongside Blue Nile fighting and RSF drone strikes on El Obeid. Specific locations and casualty figures were not independently verified.
